description: Fork of exp683 (1.4300 @ 140M, E=144 d_v=24, single read_out arch). Replace one big read_out (NAP=5 tph=1536, 18.87M) with SIX per-layer residual_lut (NAP=5 tph=256, 3.15M each = 18.87M total). Each residual_lut: input=E=144 -> output=D=384 with MeanAbsNorm(E) pre-norm. Dual-stream design: E-stream carries x_lut through blocks (identity skip + out_proj), D-stream is accumulated from per-layer residual_lut outputs. Final unembedder reads x_resid (D=384) through ln_final(D). Same total params (~140M), same LUT bandwidth (residual contribution: 2.25 MB/token either way), only the integration is redistributed across layers. Tests whether per-layer residual_lut beats single end-of-model read_out at same param/bandwidth budget. References: exp683 = 1.4300 @ 140M (single read_out), exp611 = 1.4047 @ 289M, exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M.
